posts.name: Anirvan
posts.cooked:
The question is given as follows:

A company has 5 departments, each named Dept1 to Dept5. Within each department, there are 3 teams labeled TeamA to TeamC. Each team works on 10 projects.

There is a directory for every team in ~/se2001/BPT1_problem_1/.

As of now, I do not see any directory for any team in BPT1_problem_1.

So my question is that do we have to create the directories or will the team do it?

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: You have to create all the required directories.

posts.name: Seetaramayya Lavu
posts.cooked: “synchro init” command will create the directories as mentioned in the problem. we need to create only the files for projects inside all directories. Please watch https://youtube.com/live/QUKbKhNdNLs to clarify doubts. The first problem is explained around 1:05 min
